summary.text: Aaron Kaufman is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 18 who has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kaufman earned an A.A. in general studies from Montgomery College in 2009 and a B.A. in American studies from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2011.
His career experience includes working as a senior legislative associate with The Jewish Federations of North America and a public policy specialist with The Arc of Maryland.
Kaufman succeeded Alfred Carr in the House of Delegates and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Judiciary Committee.
